svg.title: Simplified UAV software architecture, corrected
svg.desc: Ground station with QGroundControl over RFD900x and RC transmitter over FrSky X8R links to the Cube Orange. The Cube links to the Jetson Orin Nano over uXRCE-DDS. The D435i driver feeds cuVSLAM and the odom bridge into the uXRCE-DDS agent. Mission config and die localizer feed the mission manager, which drives offboard GNC into the uXRCE-DDS agent. PX4 state flows back from the uXRCE-DDS agent to the mission manager. Arducam driver feeds die detector and die localizer. VIO health reads cuVSLAM and feeds the safety monitor, which commands PX4.
